assets.prompt: Create a polished art-direction concept sheet for a dm Austria Black Friday Glückskorb mobile catcher game. ONE complete matching set of SEVEN illustrated game assets, all fully visible and separated with generous spacing: (1) a magenta/red plastic shopping basket with dark navy carry handles, woven slots and a small white front badge reading lowercase dm, three-quarter view; (2) curved aqua-cyan and pink Balea shower gel bottle with flip cap and small wave label; (3) emerald-green alverde serum dropper bottle with golden pipette/collar and leaf label; (4) pastel pink teardrop ebelin beauty sponge with a tiny sparkle; (5) rare gold/yellow Black Friday coupon ticket bearing only -20% with golden sparkles; (6) charcoal-black spiky price-devil bomb with burning fuse and bright magenta angry X mark; (7) crushed brown cardboard box. Consistent camera, lighting, proportions, polished silhouettes, readable at small game-icon size. Palette navy #002855/#0A1931, magenta #E4003A/#FF1E56, cyan #009FE3, gold #FFD100/#F59E0B, natural emerald and cardboard browns only on appropriate objects. Landscape 1800x1100 art board: large hero basket at left, six remaining icons in a spacious 3-column by 2-row layout to the right, without cards or UI. Deep navy background with restrained subtle studio glow, assets are visually isolated on the board, no scenery. No humans, hands, extra products or explanatory text. Only tiny dm/Balea/alverde packaging labels and the -20% coupon marking are permitted. DIRECTION A: soft premium 3D toy collectibles, rounded bevelled forms, satin/glossy clay and plastic, studio render quality like crafted animated film props. Soft key light from top-left, delicate rim light, diffuse contact shadows. Basket thick believable plastic rim and dimensional perforations, bottles beautifully modelled with glossy curved highlights, sponge visibly velvety, coupon thick embossed gold paper. Hazards playful and immediately distinguishable. Controlled tasteful color, highly finished commercial game asset collection, clean and friendly.
